lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lag lag preet bahu preet lagaaee lag saadhoo sa(n)g savaare ||
lines.translation: Fall in love, fall deeply in love with the Lord; clinging to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you will be exalted and embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke bachan sat sat kar maane mere thaakur bahut piaare ||6||
lines.translation: Those who accept the Word of the Guru as True, totally True, are very dear to my Lord and Master. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਪਰਚੂਨ ਕਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab janam parachoon kamaae har har har naam piaare ||
lines.translation: Because of actions committed in past lives, one comes to love the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad a(n)mrit ras paaiaa ras gaavai ras veechaare ||7||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the ambrosial essence; sing of this essence, and reflect upon this essence. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har roop ra(n)g sabh tere mere laalan laal gulaare ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, all forms and colors are Yours; O my Beloved, my deep crimson ruby.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa ra(n)g dehi so hovai kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaare ||8||3||
lines.translation: Only that color which You impart, Lord, exists; O Nanak, what can the poor wretched being do? ||8||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam gur saran prabhoo rakhavaare ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord God saves and protects us,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਪਕਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu ku(n)char tadooai pakar chalaaio kar oopar kadh nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: as He protected the elephant, when the crocodile seized it and pulled it into the water; He lifted him up and pulled him out. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh ke sevak bahut at neeke man saradhaa kar har dhaare ||
lines.translation: God's servants are sublime and exalted; they enshrine faith for Him in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mere prabh saradhaa bhagat man bhaavai jan kee paij savaare ||1||
lines.translation: Faith and devotion are pleasing to my God's Mind; He saves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har sevak sevaa laagai sabh dekhai braham pasaare ||
lines.translation: The servant of the Lord, Har, Har, is committed to His service; He sees God pervading the entire expanse of the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ek purakh ik nadaree aavai sabh ekaa nadar nihaare ||2||
lines.translation: He sees the One and only Primal Lord God, who blesses all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਚੇਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh thaakur raviaa sabh thaaee sabh cheree jagat samaare ||
lines.translation: God, our Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading all places; He takes care of the whole world as His slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aap daiaal daiaa daan devai vich paathar keere kaare ||3||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself mercifully gives His gifts, even to worms in stones. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੁਸਕਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਸਿੰਙ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar vaas bahut musakaaee bhram bhoolaa mirag si(n)nghaare ||
lines.translation: Within the deer is the heavy fragrance of musk, but he is confused and deluded, and he shakes his horns looking for it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ban ban dhoodh dhoodh phir thaakee gur poorai ghar nisataare ||4||
lines.translation: Wandering, rambling and roaming through the forests and woods, I exhausted myself, and then in my own home, the Perfect Guru saved me. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee guroo guroo hai baanee vich baanee a(n)mrit saare ||
lines.translation: The Word, the Bani is Guru, and Guru is the Bani. Within the Bani, the Ambrosial Nectar is contained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur baanee kahai sevak jan maanai paratakh guroo nisataare ||5||
lines.translation: If His humble servant believes, and acts according to the Words of the Guru's Bani, then the Guru, in person, emancipates him. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਖਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh hai braham braham hai pasariaa man beejiaa khaavaare ||
lines.translation: All is God, and God is the whole expanse; man eats what he has planted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਨ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹਾਂਸੁ ਦੁਖਿਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਸਟਬੁਧੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਲੂਕੀ ਜਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jan cha(n)drahaa(n)s dukhiaa dhrisatabudhee apunaa ghar lookee jaare ||6||
lines.translation: When Dhrishtabudhi tormented the humble devotee Chandrahaans, he only set his own house on fire. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਲੋਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kau jan a(n)tar rid lochai prabh jan ke saas nihaare ||
lines.translation: God's humble servant longs for Him within his heart; God watches over each breath of His humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar bhagat driRaae jan peechhai jag nisataare ||7||
lines.translation: Mercifully, mercifully, He implants devotion within his humble servant; for his sake, God saves the whole world. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan aap aap prabh thaakur prabh aape srisat savaare ||
lines.translation: God, our Lord and Master, is Himself by Himself; God Himself embellishes the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai kar kripaa aap nisataare ||8||4||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, He Himself is all-pervading; in His Mercy, He Himself emancipates all. ||8||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam kar kirapaa lehu ubaare ||
lines.translation: Grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਦੁਸਟਾਂ ਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu pakar dropatee dusataa(n) aanee har har laaj nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: as You saved Dropadi from shame when she was seized and brought before the court by the evil villians. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa jaachik jan tere ik maagau daan piaare ||
lines.translation: Bless me with Your Grace - I am just a humble beggar of Yours; I beg for a single blessing, O my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee nit saradhaa laagee mo kau har gur mel savaare ||1||
lines.translation: I long constantly for the True Guru. Lead me to meet the Guru, O Lord, that I may be exalted and embellished. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਮ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਥੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਝੋਲ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat karam paanee jiu matheeai nit paanee jhol jhulaare ||
lines.translation: The actions of the faithless cynic are like the churning of water; he churns, constantly churning only water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਢਿ ਮਾਖਨ ਕੇ ਗਟਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat param pad paaiaa kadh maakhan ke gatakaare ||2||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the supreme status is obtained; the butter is produced, and eaten with delight. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit nit kaaiaa majan keeaa nit mal mal deh savaare ||
lines.translation: He may constantly and continually wash his body; he may constantly rub, clean and polish his body.
